task.title: L12.24 similar-rows mixed-loop safety, twin cap and blueprint container scope: implement, verify, close
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-05: implement awkit-djnl.21.24. Priority 1: a similar-rows loop picked from one Approve must never also match Reject, Delete or any other action; refuse when a safe repeated selector cannot be proven; red-first deterministic coverage for Approve vs Reject, Approve vs Delete, same text with different semantic attributes, icon-only, disabled and hidden siblings, reordered actions, nested controls, subset rows and a deliberately ambiguous case, with a mutation-tested gate. Then: decide with evidence whether the 8-twin cap permits a wrong recovery and fix it only if so, and make the blueprint layer respect a proven container. Keep 0 wrong, removed targets empty, 11/14, 3 identical runs and the latency budgets. Describe Layer 4 as synthetic. L12.23 and L12.22 are not reopened.

The twin cap and blueprint container residuals each have a corpus case that was WRONG before and refuses after, and verify:dom-intelligence-coverage keeps 0 wrong, removed targets empty, identical runs and the budgets, with table-actions pinned to a loop over Approve only.

The acceptance benchmark keeps 0 wrong and at least 11 of 14 product recoveries, and Element Spy, similar rows, locator recovery, runner, mock-site, build, script typecheck and verifier classification stay green.
